## Hosted Fields

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/hosted-fields/overview): In order to be eligible for the easiest level of PCI compliance - - certain payment fields on the checkout page must be hosted securely.
- [Examples](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/hosted-fields/examples/javascript/v3): We created these examples to show a few of the many possibilities of styling Hosted Fields.

- [Styling](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/hosted-fields/styling/): Hosted Fields defers as much of the styling of field components to you as possible.
